# HomuraJS

> Time Travel State & History Engine for JavaScript ("Git for application state")

Built by Biagio Scaglia & HomuraJS Team — https://github.com/biagio-scaglia

HomuraJS models application state mutations as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of immutable states with non-destructive branch divergence, zero-dependency Copy-On-Write draft proxies, deep recursive structural diffing, atomic transactions, step-by-step replay, and diagnostic DevTools.

## Packages

- `@biagioscaglia/homurajs`: Unified meta-package bundle for Node.js, bundlers, and browsers via CDN.
- `@homura-js/core`: Core DAG state engine, structural diff, snapshots, persistence, and middleware.
- `@homura-js/devtools`: Embedded diagnostic UI with visual timeline tree, JSON state inspector, diff viewer, and playback controls.
- `@homura-js/react`: React 18+ integration hook (`useHomura`) powered by `useSyncExternalStore` with selector optimization.
- `@homura-js/vue`: Vue 3 Composition API hook (`useHomura`) and plugin.
- `@homura-js/vanilla`: Frameworkless reactive DOM bindings (`bindState`) and zero-JS form auto-recovery engine (`bindForm`, `data-homura-form`).

## Pages & Documentation

- Homepage & Documentation: https://biagio-scaglia.github.io/homura-js/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/biagio-scaglia/homura-js
- npm Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@biagioscaglia/homurajs

## Quick Start (JavaScript / TypeScript)

```ts
import { createHomura } from '@homura-js/core';

const homura = createHomura({
  initialState: { count: 0, user: 'Homura' }
});

// Mutate via Copy-On-Write draft proxy
homura.update(draft => {
  draft.count += 10;
}, { label: 'Increment' });

// Time travel navigation
homura.undo(); // count -> 0
homura.redo(); // count -> 10
```

## Quick Start (HTML / Static Sites / WordPress)

```html
<script src="https://unpkg.com/@biagioscaglia/homurajs/dist/index.global.js"></script>

<form data-homura-form="contact" data-homura-persist="localstorage">
  <input name="email" type="email" />
  <button type="button" data-homura-undo>Undo</button>
  <button type="button" data-homura-redo>Redo</button>
</form>
```
